name: Kouzaki
source:
Senpai of the protagonist. Is  stoic and mysterious but also very insightful. 

[spoiler] Is one of guardians of magic book. She was created by magic book to watch over it and has been reincarnated several times. She is now trying to fix the wish of book so everyone can move on.  [/spoiler]
